# Wheelhouser LLC — Complete Technical, Executive & Commercial Reference (`llms-full.txt`)

> Comprehensive reference for AI search engines, procurement teams, coding assistants, and enterprise system administrators covering Wheelhouser LLC's Custom Cross-Platform Desktop App Engineering services, Founder Steve Rock's executive credentials, Flagship Marquee-Magic platform, Core Workstation Suite, and signed Linux repository installation commands.

### Sovereign Privacy & Zero-Ad Guarantee
Wheelhouser LLC operates under an ironclad privacy standard across all products and custom engagements:
- **Zero Tracking:** Zero hidden telemetry beacons, usage surveillance, keystroke logging, or cross-app fingerprinting.
- **Customer Data Never Used or Sold:** Customer files, prompts, configurations, and operational data remain strictly on client hardware and are never harvested, trained on, monetized, or sold to third parties.
- **100% Ad-Free Forever:** Zero ad networks, sponsored clutter, or dark-pattern interruptions in any Wheelhouser application or platform.

### Founder Executive Credentials — Steve Rock, M.S.
1. **Founder & Principal Systems Architect — Wheelhouser LLC:** Architected and shipped the commercial Marquee-Magic digital signage ecosystem, 14+ native cross-platform desktop applications across Windows, macOS, and 6+ Enterprise Linux distributions, and the cryptographic multi-distro repository infrastructure at `repo.wheelhouser.com`.
2. **Lead Technical Product Manager, Strategy — Optum:** Directed enterprise technical product strategy, multi-horizon platform roadmaps, and regulated healthcare technology initiatives at Fortune-5 scale.
3. **Global Product Manager, Industrial Internet of Things (IIoT) — Xylem:** Led global IIoT hardware-connected software portfolios, edge telemetry analytics, and mission-critical infrastructure platforms across international industrial markets.
4. **Master of Science (M.S.) in Optical Physics — NASA Space Grant Scholar:** Graduate research fellow in photonics, laser/optical instrumentation, computational modeling, and precision signal acquisition.
5. **United States Air Force Veteran — Global War on Terror:** Honorably served in high-accountability operational missions establishing lifelong discipline in zero-defect systems execution and operational security.

## Commercial Service Offering: Custom Cross-Platform Desktop Applications

- **Service Page:** https://wheelhouser.com/services.html
- **Interactive Brief & Quote Composer:** https://wheelhouser.com/services.html#inquire
- **Scope:** End-to-end architecture, native UI engineering (Python, Qt6/PySide6, C++, Rust), hardware/IIoT integration, on-device AI inference, cryptographic code-signing, and turnkey installer pipelines across:
  - **Windows 10 & Windows 11:** Authenticode & Microsoft Store MSIX packages, WinGet manifests, silent enterprise deployment.
  - **macOS (Apple Silicon ARM64 & Intel x86_64):** Universal binaries, Apple Developer ID code-signing, notarization, and stapled DMG installers.
  - **Enterprise & Desktop Linux:** 4096-bit RSA GPG-signed RPM (Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, RHEL 10, Fedora 44/45) and DEB (Debian 13, Ubuntu 24.04/26.04 LTS) packages plus optional dedicated DNF/APT update channels.
- **Commercial Terms:** Direct principal-led execution (zero junior agency handoffs), clean source code handoff, automated CI/CD build pipelines, and 100% client intellectual property ownership upon milestone completion.

## Enterprise Linux Repository Setup (`repo.wheelhouser.com`)

Wheelhouser LLC maintains signed native repositories for Enterprise Linux, Fedora, Debian, and Ubuntu.

### Rocky Linux 10
```bash
sudo dnf install https://repo.wheelhouser.com/rocky/10/x86_64/steve-rock-wheelhouser-release-1.0-6.el10.noarch.rpm
```

### AlmaLinux 10
```bash
sudo dnf install https://repo.wheelhouser.com/almalinux/10/x86_64/steve-rock-wheelhouser-release-1.0-6.el10.noarch.rpm
```

### Fedora Linux 44 & 45
```bash
sudo dnf install https://repo.wheelhouser.com/fedora/44/x86_64/steve-rock-wheelhouser-release-1.0-6.fc44.noarch.rpm
```

### Debian 13 (Trixie)
```bash
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && \
curl -fsSL https://repo.wheelhouser.com/steve-rock-wheelhouser-gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg] https://repo.wheelhouser.com/debian/13 ./" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/wheelhouser.list && \
sudo apt update
```

### Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Resolute) & 24.04 LTS
```bash
sudo install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings && \
curl -fsSL https://repo.wheelhouser.com/steve-rock-wheelhouser-gpg.key | sudo gpg --dearmor --yes -o /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
sudo chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg && \
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/wheelhouser.gpg] https://repo.wheelhouser.com/ubuntu/26.04 ./" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/wheelhouser.list && \
sudo apt update
```

## Product Suite Technical Reference

### 1. Marquee-Magic (Flagship Commercial Digital Signage Ecosystem)
- **URL:** https://Marquee-Magic.com
- **Platforms:** Windows, macOS, Linux
- **Summary:** Self-owned commercial digital signage ecosystem featuring Designer Studio, portable & multi-screen wall players, 60fps hardware-accelerated rendering, and perpetual offline playback without recurring SaaS fees.

### 2. Wheelhouser Web Browser (`web-browser`) — Core Workstation Suite
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/web-browser.html
- **Package Name:** `web-browser`
- **Version:** 0.24.2
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6, QtWebEngine (Chromium)
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11, macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel)
- **Capabilities:** Privacy-first desktop browser with built-in ad/tracker blocking, real-time seekable media stream transcoding, live-favicon bookmark trees, multi-tab session persistence, and unified local directory browsing.

### 3. Wheelhouser File Browser (`file-browser`) — Core Workstation Suite
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/file-browser.html
- **Package Name:** `file-browser`
- **Version:** 0.10.0
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6 / Qt6
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11, macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel)
- **Capabilities:** Dual-pane and multi-tab file navigation, embedded synchronized PTY dual terminal emulator, instant code/image/markdown preview panes, and native dark mode.

### 4. Wheelhouser Text Editor (`text-editor`) — Core Workstation Suite
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-editor.html
- **Package Name:** `text-editor`
- **Version:** 0.14.2
- **Stack:** Python 3.13, PySide6 / Qt6
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11 (Microsoft Store `9PDMKDMPCJRG`), macOS 12+
- **Capabilities:** Multi-cursor editing (`Ctrl+Click`, `Ctrl+D`), syntax highlighting across 15+ languages (Python, C/C++, Rust, Go, JS/TS, HTML/CSS, Shell, JSON, Markdown), persistent code folding, regex find & replace, real-time spell check, and Wheelhouser Dark Mode.

### 5. Wheelhouser Terminal (`terminal`) — Core Workstation Suite
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/terminal.html
- **Package Name:** `terminal`
- **Version:** 0.32.0
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6 / Qt6, PTY & Built-In POSIX Suite
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11 (Microsoft Store `9N2HWXSPTS19`), macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel)
- **Capabilities:** Hardware-accelerated multi-tab desktop terminal emulator, built-in Unix/POSIX utilities natively on Windows (`ssh`, `scp`, `rsync`, `grep`, `awk`, `sed`, `curl`, `tar`, `htop`, `git`), 24-bit TrueColor ANSI themes, and private local WAI command assistance.
- **Install:** `sudo dnf install -y terminal` or `sudo apt install -y terminal`

### 6. Google Antigravity IDE (Linux Enterprise Packaging)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/antigravity-ide.html
- **Package Name:** `antigravity-ide`
- **Version:** 1.0.0-1
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS (Windows & macOS provided natively by Google)
- **Capabilities:** Official Linux RPM and DEB packaging suite, XDG desktop launcher (`antigravity-ide.desktop`), MIME-type associations, single-instance session lock, and orphaned agent daemon cleanup.

### 7. Wheelhouser Git Tools (`git-tools`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/git-tools.html
- **Package Name:** `git-tools`
- **Version:** 1.10.1
- **Stack:** Python 3.12/3.13, PySide6, Rich, Bash, PowerShell
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44/45, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, Windows 10/11 (MSIX), macOS 12+ (ARM64 & Intel DMG)
- **Capabilities:** Smart `push`/`pull` autostash workflows, `undo` soft rollback, `git-tools dashboard` interactive repository fleet TUI, and `git-tools scan-secrets` credential leak guard.

### 8. Wheelhouser Auto-Updates (`auto-updates`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/auto-updates.html
- **Package Name:** `auto-updates`
- **Version:** 1.4.3-1
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, AlmaLinux 10, Fedora 44, Debian 13, Ubuntu 26.04 LTS
- **Capabilities:** Unified multi-distro CLI wrapping `dnf-automatic` and `unattended-upgrades`, daily zero-day security patching, and active compiler/build lock detection (`gcc`, `cargo`, `make`, `ninja`, `rpmbuild`, `containerd`).

### 9. Rocky Linux Setup (`rocky-linux-setup`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/rocky-linux-setup.html
- **Package Name:** `rocky-linux-setup`
- **Version:** 1.1.0-1
- **Platforms:** Rocky Linux 10, Enterprise Linux 10, RHEL 10
- **Capabilities:** Automated workstation meta-package enabling CRB, EPEL 10, and the Wheelhouser RPM repository, developer build toolchains, and unattended Kickstart profiles.

### 10. Wheelhouser Create Icon Files (`create-icon-files`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/create-icon-files.html
- **Version:** 1.2.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE/Store), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** Converts a single master image into complete cross-platform icon sets (16x16 to 1024x1024), Freedesktop `share/icons/hicolor` trees, Windows `.ico`, and macOS `.icns` bundles.

### 11. Wheelhouser Image Background Remover (`image-background-remover`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-background-remover.html
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** 100% offline, on-device AI subject isolation and batch folder background removal powered by RemBG.

### 12. Wheelhouser Image Inpainter (`image-inpainter`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-inpainter.html
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** On-device LaMa AI neural network inpainting to erase unwanted objects, people, watermarks, and blemishes from photographs locally.

### 13. Wheelhouser Image Resizer (`image-resizer`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/image-resizer.html
- **Version:** 0.3.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** High-speed batch image resizing, smart aspect-ratio cropping, compression tuning, and format conversion across PNG, JPG, WEBP, SVG, TIFF, AVIF, PDF, and BMP.

### 14. Wheelhouser Text to Speech (`text-to-speech`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/text-to-speech.html
- **Version:** 0.1.0
- **Platforms:** Linux (RPM), Windows (EXE), macOS (DMG)
- **Capabilities:** Lifelike neural text-to-speech synthesis powered by Microsoft Edge Neural TTS with multi-language voices, pitch/rate tuning, and direct MP3 export.

### 15. Wheelhouser Notez (`notez`)
- **URL:** https://wheelhouser.com/products/notez.html
- **Version:** 1.4.0
- **Platforms:** Windows (Linux & macOS in active development)
- **Capabilities:** Lightweight, instant-launch local Markdown note-taking desktop application.
